about: D432's table of the server's rules the document seam follows: every row names the cells that hold it (a Python cell as path::function, a vitest cell as path::the string of its title). Read by web/tests/gates/spec-names.test.ts (every cell exists; D432's prose and the seam's source comments state no rule of the server outside this table; a why states a fact of the seam or of the corpus, never one of the server) and by server/tests/core/catalog/test_builder_documents.py (the bound rows are the bounds of the server's models, and every edge row has an edge pair in the corpus).

rows.rule: The datatypes a view's column may be of are distribution.SUMMARISED, and distribution._CATEGORIES under a floor: the seam's lists equal the server's sets, and the seam offers a unit's own table's columns of those datatypes (boolean and category under a floor; no number column).

The datatypes a value leaf's column may be of are those whose resolve.typed_constant takes every string (string, category and list<category>), less list<category>, which the seam leaves out (M5.3-rest's to offer); boolean is no leaf.
Every word of the lists is a member of ColumnBrief.datatype.

A view column is valid, or refused with exactly one code at one path, by its relation to the unit (its own table, a parent or a grandparent above it, or another: a child, or a sibling below a shared child), its datatype and the floor: a string, date or datetime column is NOT_SUPPORTED at its column under every k; list<category> is AGGREGATE_REQUIRED; under a floor a number, integer or time_offset column is MISSING_MEMBER at its bins; a column of a table that is no unit or ancestor of the unit is AGGREGATE_REQUIRED whatever its datatype.

The columns of an ancestor table of the unit (a parent, a grandparent) of the lists' datatypes are taken like the unit's own, and the seam does not offer them (a view choice is held to its unit's own table); a column of a table below the unit, or of a sibling's through a shared child, is AGGREGATE_REQUIRED.

Every view column the seam offers is valid at validate_document, count_cohort and run_analysis, under no floor, a floor of 5 and one of 50, in every unit of the orchard, the lab, a chain of three tables and two tables sharing a child.

In the four worlds of the cell (the orchard, the lab, a chain of three tables, two tables sharing a child), every leaf column the seam offers is valid whatever the unit (a lookup up, down or across the graph), and the one more the server takes is list<category>.
A category leaf of a column with permissible values refuses another value with NOT_PERMISSIBLE at the value (shown by the page through Refusal).
In the four worlds of the cell, any leaf column of the answer stands at any leaf position: the server resolves the path or refuses it, and the cell holds that each world has a path for each.

In the corpus's bodies (the orchard's, at most MAX_VALUES JSON values; a body of more is not stated), the classes are decided in this order: a body over the limit (D'), a value holding a noncharacter or a surrogate (C), a document over its bytes (D) (each entry that holds two of them is of the first); then the document's schema, all of its refusals together (a list of clauses over its bound: E; a value over its length: B; E precedes B); then the resolution, all of its refusals together (a cohort over its leaves: E; a view over its columns: F); otherwise A. count_cohort and run_analysis answer 422 with a first of the refusals.

A valid document: each written (column, value) pair is in its cohort's canonical form, unescaped, and in its readback as the data token after " is " beside its column's label (a value of more than 200 code points a token marked truncated whose text is its first 200); never UNKNOWN_PARAMETER; count_cohort and run_analysis answer 200.
A body over MAX_BODY_BYTES is 413 LIMIT_EXCEEDED at every tool.
A value holding a noncharacter (U+FDD0 to U+FDEF, or U+nFFFE or U+nFFFF of any plane) or a surrogate is 422 INVALID_JSON at /document/cohorts/<name>/all/<i>/values/0, at validate_document.

In the corpus's bodies (the orchard's, at most MAX_VALUES JSON values; a body of more is not stated), a document over MAX_DOCUMENT_BYTES by the server's measure (its JSON as json.dumps writes it) is 200 valid: false at validate_document with one LIMIT_EXCEEDED and no path, and 422 at count_cohort and run_analysis.

A value over MAX_STRING code points (unescaped) in a document under the limit is 200 valid: false, LIMIT_EXCEEDED at that value, one for each such value; count_cohort and run_analysis answer 422 at a first.

A cohort over the leaves its canonical form may hold, each down step of a path counted as a leaf of its own (a child table's leaf is two, a parent's one, a duplicate none), is 200 valid: false, LIMIT_EXCEEDED at /cohorts/<name>/all, one for each such cohort; a list over its clauses bound is refused earlier with the same code at the same path; count_cohort and run_analysis answer 422.

A view of more columns than summary.distribution takes is 200 valid: false, LIMIT_EXCEEDED at /views/0/params/columns, beside a cohort's refusal when both are over; the server takes a column twice in one view.
A value that starts with $ is a parameter reference unless written with one more $ (§7.1): the corpus written without the escape fails on $x.
The seam writes one or two cohorts, named first and second; a draft of none or three is refused before anything is sent.

A cohort's canonical form holds at most 64 leaves, counted by engine.resolved.measure.
A leaf of a child table is a leaf and a down step of its own: two leaves of the count (32 child-table leaves are the bound, 33 past it; 31 and two of the unit's, and 31 and three).
A cohort's canonical form nests at most 8 clauses deep, each down step of a path a level of its own.
